modelling_limitations: Values are computed from accepted shape metadata, not measured by a ray-cast probe.
No accepted module_profile_v1 exists for these rooms, so the #216 probe cannot run.
The #205 openness metric is horizontal and does not model open sky; the courtyard proxy is a deliberate extension pending operator review.
Agents cannot listen; reverb character and footstep match are pending operator review.
